game.rules:
**Hive Speedrunning Rules**

> **1. We follow The Hive's official rules,** and so must you in all of your runs. **Hacking, cross-teaming (including intentional sniping), illegal skins, and troll submissions will not be tolerated.**

> **2. All runs require video proof through YouTube** showing the run from beginning to end and in which the in-game chat and HUD are clearly visible *(Exceptions apply - see DeathRun & Gravity Category Rules)*. **Replay IDs cannot be accepted as sole proof,** but may be provided to complement video proofs.

> **3. Any run claiming to be Top 3 in any category must show pre-game lobby footage and run */p info* in the in-game chat** *(Exceptions apply - see DeathRun & Gravity Category Rules)***.** *It is good practice to do the above for all runs, Top 3 or not.*

> **4. Custom servers aren't allowed** *(DeathRun & Gravity excepted)*.

> **5. Limited-time and/or seasonal maps aren't allowed** *(Win Streaks excepted)*. Seasonal re-skins of permanent maps are acceptable.

> **6. Runs that were substantially affected by hackers in any way aren't allowed.**

> **7. Glitches, bugs, and exploits cannot be deliberately used to your advantage.**

> **8. Parties must not exceed the maximum player count for a single team** *(E.g. a party of two players cannot run SkyWars Solos)*.

**All speedruns will be retimed by our moderation team** meaning that a rough estimate of your run's time is acceptable for submission. **No on-screen timer is required.**

**The rules above apply to all categories.** However, some timing practices and rules may differ per category. **Please read category-specific rules before submitting a run.**

categories.name: Win Streaks
categories.rules:
**Win Streaks Video Proofs**

> **Both YouTube videos and/or Twitch VODs may be submitted as video proofs for Win Streaks** (uploading Twitch VODs to YouTube for permanent storage is still recommended).

> **In-game statistics** (Games Played, Victories, etc.) **must be shown in the pre-game lobby at the beginning and end of each clip submitted as video proof** (the more, the better - livestreams excepted).

> **The */p info* command must be run at least once in each clip submitted as video proof** (preferably at the beginning of the streak - the more, the better).

**Win Streaks Rules**
> **Re-queueing is allowed** (exceptions apply) **in the pre-game lobby or during the pre-game countdown** (re-queueing beyond this point ends the streak).

> **A streak may be paused to play a *different gamemode* and resumed at a later time or date** (playing the same gamemode out of the streak may alter in-game statistics and end it where it was paused).

> **Games negatively affected by *blatant hackers* may be exempted from the streak** (up to the moderation team's discretion - exceptions cannot be made for closet cheaters).

**Please provide the following timestamps in submission descriptions:**
- At least one instance of */p info*
- Beginning of streak
- End of streak

**Non-Solo Gamemodes**
> **A streak must begin and end with the same party members** (no substitutions).

> **Only one team member is required to survive and win the game** (all but one team member may be eliminated).

**Bridge Specific**
> Queue-dodging is not allowed.

categories.name: Lobby Parkour
categories.rules:
#Lobby Parkour Timing

- Time starts when the player steps on the first platform of the parkour.
- Time ends when the player steps on the checkpoint platform or the end platform, depending on the category.

***Please submit the estimated time of your run in "Time" and leave "In-game time" empty.***

categories.name: Fastest Team Elimination
categories.rules:
#Fastest Team Elimination Rules
- You must eliminate a **full** team as fast as possible (refer to gamemode-specific team size below).
- Time starts when the game introduction message (30 second grace period message for Survival Games) appears in chat at the end of the countdown.
- Time ends when the team elimination is confirmed in chat.

categories.name: Fastest Treasure Destroyed
categories.rules:
#Fastest Treasure Destroyed Rules
- You must destroy an enemy treasure as fast as possible.
- For Treasure Wars Mega, you must destroy the enemy **boss treasure** as fast as possible.
- Time starts when the game introduction message appears in chat at the end of the countdown.
- Time ends when the treasure's destruction is confirmed in chat.

categories.name: Seasonal Games
categories.rules: ***Please submit the estimated time of your run in "Time" and leave "In-game time" empty.***

categories.name: Obtain Item
categories.rules:
#Obtain Item Rules
- You must obtain a specific item as fast as possible.
- Time starts when the game introduction message (30 second grace period message for Survival Games) appears in chat at the end of the countdown.
- Time ends when the specific item appears in your inventory, or when you see the "Success!" message in the shop menu, whichever comes first.
- **Obtain Item runs can only be done in single player team gamemodes (Solos).**

categories.name: 3 Spellbooks
categories.rules:
#3 Spellbooks Rules
- You must **obtain and use** all three different Spellbooks (Healing, Swiftness, and Fire Trail) as fast as possible.
- Time starts when the game introduction message appears in chat at the end of the countdown.
- Time ends when all three different Spellbooks have been used and are no longer in your inventory.
- **3 Spellbooks runs can only be done in SkyWars Solos.**

categories.name: All Ores Mined
categories.rules:
#All Ores Mined Rules
- You must mine all six different ore types (iron, gold, redstone, lapis lazuli, diamond, and emerald) as fast as possible.
- Time starts when the game introduction message appears in chat at the end of the countdown.
- Time ends when all six different ore types have been mined.
- **All Ores Mined runs can only be done in SkyWars Solos.**

categories.name: DeathRun (NOT FOR SUBMISSION)
categories.rules:
#DeathRun Timing
- Unlike other gamemodes, runs submitted for DeathRun will not be re-timed using SPRT or yt-frame-timer.
- For DeathRun, the time used will be the completion time given in the in-game chat at the end of the run.

categories.name: All Games
categories.rules:
Win every minigame in every team mode for All Games Extended. You don't need to win in a streak. Lobby parkour isn't required. Because runs likely will take so long, breaks are allowed in between as long as you still show all parts. If you need to split clips into a few videos or streams in case your pc or device cannot handle that, it is allowed.

#Games you need to win (Bedrock Edition, All Games extended)
- **Treasure Wars**
Solos, Duos, Trios, Squads and MEGA!

- **SkyWars**
Solos, Duos, Trios and Squads

- **Survival Games**
Solos and Duos

- **Murder Mystery**
Murderer, Innocent, and Sheriff

- **Just Build**
Solos, Solos: Extended, Duos and Duos: Extended

- **Hide and Seek**
Seeker and Hider, separately

- **DeathRun**
Runner only

- ***Please submit the estimated total time of your uncut run (including queues, pre-game lobbies, and loading times) in "Time".***
- ***Please submit the estimated total time spent in-game (excluding queues, pre-game lobbies, and loading times) in "In-game time".***

categories.name: Parkour Worlds
categories.rules:
# Parkour Worlds Timing

- Unlike most other categories, Parkour Worlds submissions will not be retimed by our moderation team and only require a screenshot of the in-game chat message or video of the full run containing your time at the end of the run.
- Submissions claiming to be top 3 for that map must have video proof. Any other placement below top 3 may be a screenshot. All proof must abide by the rules outlined below.

# Parkour Worlds Rules

- Mounts or any marketplace related items are disallowed.
- You must do the parkour solo, without other players assisting you (by pressing pressure plates, etc.)
- Top 3 runs require video proof.

categories.name: SkyWars
categories.rules:
**SkyWars Categories**

> **Any% -** The game is **not required to be full** (up to **half** of the enemy players may be absent or disconnect mid-game). *Refer to gamemode-specific player counts below.*

> **Full% -** The game **must begin and remain full** (enemy players may not disconnect mid-game). *The running team is not required to be full.*

> **Perfect% -** On top of Full% requirements, **all enemy players must be eliminated by the running team.**

**SkyWars Timing**
> Time starts when the introduction message appears in chat after the 10 second countdown.

> Time ends when the game over message appears in chat.

**SkyWars Player Counts**
- Solos: **12** teams of **1** *(Total: **12**) - Up to **6** missing enemies*
- Duos: **6** teams of **2** *(Total: **12**) - Up to **5** missing enemies*
- Trios: **4** teams of **3** *(Total: **12**) - Up to **5** missing enemies*
- Squads: **4** teams of **4** *(Total: **16**) - Up to **6** missing enemies*
- Mega: **4** teams of **7** *(Total: **28**) - Up to **11** missing enemies*

categories.rules:

> **Full% -** The game **must begin and remain full** (enemy players may not disconnect mid-game). The running team is not required to be full.

> **Perfect% -** On top of Full% requirements, **all enemy players and beds must be eliminated by the running team.**

**Bedwars Timing**

> Time starts when the game HUD appears after the 5 second countdown.

> Time ends when the game over message appears in chat.

**Bedwars Player Counts**

categories.name: PC/Console
categories.rules:
# DeathRun Timing

- Unlike most other categories, DeathRun submissions will not be retimed by our moderation team and only require a screenshot of the in-game chat message or video of the full run containing your time at the end of the run.
- Submissions claiming to be top 3 for that map must have video proof. Any other placement below top 3 may be a screenshot. All proof must abide by the rules outlined below.

# DeathRun Rules

- If running in a Custom Server, your screenshot or video submission must include the custom server's settings used in your run.
- If using a mobile device but playing via controller or mouse and keyboard, we ask that you submit the run to the PC/Console category and list the Platform used as your mobile device *(iOS or Android)*.
- Using a trap activated by a Death player to somehow assist or boost you in a speedrun is prohibited.
- Adjusting the Trap Cooldown setting to anything other than its default 1.0x modifier is prohibited.

categories.name: Murder Mystery

**Murder Mystery Categories**

- **Murderer**
> **Any% -** The game is **not required to be full.** (up to **half** of the Innocents may be absent or disconnect mid-game). *Refer to gamemode-specific player count below.*

> **Full% -** The game **must begin and remain full** (Innocents may not disconnect mid-game).

> **Perfect% -** On top of Full% requirements, **all Innocents must be eliminated by the Murderer only.**

- **Sheriff**
> **Any% - Eliminate the Murderer as fast as possible.** The game is **not required to be full** (up to **half** of the Innocents can be absent or disconnect mid-game). *Refer to gamemode-specific player count below.*

**Murder Mystery Timing**

**Murder Mystery Player Count**

categories.name: Gravity
categories.rules:
# Gravity Timing

- Unlike most other categories, Gravity submissions will not be retimed by our moderation team and only require a screenshot of the in-game chat message containing your time at the end of the run.
- Submissions claiming to be top 3 for that map must have video proof. Any other placement below top 3 may be a screenshot. All proof must abide by the rules outlined below.

# Gravity Rules

- The screenshot must show your entire screen. Video must show the entire run of the map from spawning into the map, to finishing in the portal with the time displayed in chat.
- Custom server runs MUST SHOW the server's settings in chat (if screenshot). Custom server settings do not need to be displayed in video submissions.
- "Player Lives Amount" setting in custom servers must be set to Default.

NOTE: Currently custom servers do not show the time it took to complete each map individually. For individual map runs, you can bypass this by setting "Map Amount" setting to 1 and then selecting only the map you'd like to run.

values.name: Infinite Leap

values.name: The Bridge
values.rules:
**The Bridge Rules**

> The game is **required to begin and remain full** until three goals are scored by the running team (enemy players may not disconnect mid-game). *For Duos, the running team is also required to be full.*  **/p info is NOT required for Bridge Solo, as you cannot join this mode in a party.**

**The Bridge Timing**

- Time starts when your items appear in your hotbar.
- Time ends when the game is confirmed over in chat.

**The Bridge Player Counts**

- Solos: **2** teams of **1** *(Total: **2**)*

values.name: Capture the Flag

values.name: 5 Maps
values.rules:
# 5 Maps Rules

- Only 5 maps may be played for the run, no more no less. It can be any order of 5 different maps. Custom servers to hand-pick the maps are allowed.
- If a custom server is used, the "Map Amount" setting must be set to 5. This setting must be displayed in chat (for screenshots) or before the game starts (for video)

values.name: 5 Maps (No Custom Server)
values.rules:
# 5 Maps (No Custom Server) Rules

- Get the fastest possible time on any 5 maps.
- Custom servers to handpick maps are **NOT ALLOWED**!

categories.name: Gravity
categories.rules:
# Gravity Timing

- Unlike most other categories, Gravity submissions will not be retimed by our moderation team and only require a screenshot of the in-game chat message containing your time at the end of the run.
- Submissions claiming to be top 3 for that map must have video proof. Any other placement below top 3 may be a screenshot. All proof must abide by the rules outlined below.

# Gravity Rules

- The screenshot must show your entire screen. Video must show the entire run of the map from spawning into the map, to finishing in the portal with the time displayed in chat.
- Custom server runs MUST SHOW the server's settings in chat (if screenshot). Custom server settings do not need to be displayed in video submissions.
- "Player Lives Amount" setting in custom servers must be set to Default.

NOTE: Currently custom servers do not show the time it took to complete each map individually. For individual map runs, you can bypass this by setting "Map Amount" setting to 1 and then selecting only the map you'd like to run.

games.name: Hive Minigames
games.rules:
**Hive Speedrunning Rules**

> **1. We follow The Hive's official rules,** and so must you in all of your runs. **Hacking, cross-teaming (including intentional sniping), illegal skins, and troll submissions will not be tolerated.**

> **2. All runs require video proof through YouTube** showing the run from beginning to end and in which the in-game chat and HUD are clearly visible *(Exceptions apply - see DeathRun & Gravity Category Rules)*. **Replay IDs cannot be accepted as sole proof,** but may be provided to complement video proofs.

> **3. Any run claiming to be Top 3 in any category must show pre-game lobby footage and run */p info* in the in-game chat** *(Exceptions apply - see DeathRun & Gravity Category Rules)***.** *It is good practice to do the above for all runs, Top 3 or not.*

> **4. Custom servers aren't allowed** *(DeathRun & Gravity excepted)*.

> **5. Limited-time and/or seasonal maps aren't allowed** *(Win Streaks excepted)*. Seasonal re-skins of permanent maps are acceptable.

> **6. Runs that were substantially affected by hackers in any way aren't allowed.**

> **7. Glitches, bugs, and exploits cannot be deliberately used to your advantage.**

> **8. Parties must not exceed the maximum player count for a single team** *(E.g. a party of two players cannot run SkyWars Solos)*.

**All speedruns will be retimed by our moderation team** meaning that a rough estimate of your run's time is acceptable for submission. **No on-screen timer is required.**

**The rules above apply to all categories.** However, some timing practices and rules may differ per category. **Please read category-specific rules before submitting a run.**

values.name: Infinite Leap
values.rules: **For Infinite Leap, you may use any shortcuts you can find *(glitching out of the map using leaps is allowed)*.**

values.name: Leapless
values.rules: **Leapless runs on all platforms require full video proof to be eligible, since this is the only way to prove that no leap was used throughout the run.**

values.name: Capture the Flag
values.rules:
**Capture The Flag Rules**
> The game is **not required to be full** (up to **half** of the enemy players may be absent or disconnect mid-game). *Refer to gamemode-specific player count below.*

**Capture The Flag Timing**
- Time starts when your items appear in your hotbar.
- Time ends when the game is confirmed over in chat.

**Capture The Flag Player Count**
- **2** teams of **6** *(Total: **12**) - Up to **3** missing enemies*

values.name: The Bridge
values.rules:
**The Bridge Rules**

> The game is **required to begin and remain full** until three goals are scored by the running team (enemy players may not disconnect mid-game). *For Duos, the running team is also required to be full.*  **/p info is NOT required for Bridge Solo, as you cannot join this mode in a party.**

**The Bridge Timing**

- Time starts when your items appear in your hotbar.
- Time ends when the game is confirmed over in chat.

**The Bridge Player Counts**

- Solos: **2** teams of **1** *(Total: **2**)*
- Duos: **2** teams of **2** *(Total: **4**)*

values.name: 5 Maps
values.rules:
# 5 Maps Rules

- Only 5 maps may be played for the run, no more no less. It can be any order of 5 different maps. Custom servers to hand-pick the maps are allowed.
- If a custom server is used, the "Map Amount" setting must be set to 5. This setting must be displayed in chat (for screenshots) or before the game starts (for video)

values.name: 5 Maps (No Custom Server)
values.rules:
# 5 Maps (No Custom Server) Rules

- Get the fastest possible time on any 5 maps.
- Custom servers to handpick maps are **NOT ALLOWED**!
